title: Universality classes split by strong and weak symmetries
summary: Dissipative phase transitions are strongly shaped by the symmetries of the Liouvillian, yet a clear understanding of the quantitative impact of weak and strong symmetries on critical behavior is presently lacking. We study a squeezed-photon model with single- and two-photon losses, realizing weak and strong symmetries in the simplest possible setting. The two symmetries exhibit identical Gaussian static fluctuations, whereas the order parameter and the asymptotic decay rate display distinct scaling behaviors.
